title: Joshua Bible Quiz - Chapter 14
description: Ten questions on Joshua 14: the land divided by lot and Caleb's request for Hebron at eighty-five years old.

questions.text: Which priest helped distribute the inheritances in the land of Canaan?
questions.explanation: Eleazar the priest, Joshua the son of Nun, and the heads of the fathers' houses distributed the inheritances.

questions.text: How was the inheritance distributed to the nine and a half tribes?
questions.explanation: It was distributed by the lot of their inheritance, as Yahweh commanded by Moses.

answers.text: By a vote of the elders
By the size of each army

questions.text: Which two tribes came from the children of Joseph?
questions.explanation: The children of Joseph were two tribes, Manasseh and Ephraim.

questions.text: What did the Levites receive instead of a portion of the land?
questions.explanation: No portion was given to the Levites in the land, except cities to dwell in, with their pasture lands.

answers.text: The hill country of Hebron and its fields
Cities to dwell in, with their pasture lands
All of Gilead and Bashan beyond the Jordan
A double portion of land near Gilgal

questions.explanation: The text calls him Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite.

questions.text: How old was Caleb when Moses sent him from Kadesh Barnea to spy out the land?
questions.explanation: Caleb said he was forty years old when Moses sent him from Kadesh Barnea to spy out the land.

questions.text: What did Caleb say his brothers who went up with him did?
questions.explanation: Caleb said his brothers who went up with him made the heart of the people melt, but he wholly followed Yahweh.

answers.text: They brought back the same report as he did
They made the heart of the people melt
They stayed behind at Kadesh Barnea
They asked for Hebron for themselves

questions.text: How old did Caleb say he was on the day he spoke to Joshua?
questions.explanation: Caleb told Joshua that he was eighty-five years old that day.

questions.text: Which city did Joshua give to Caleb for an inheritance?
questions.explanation: Joshua blessed Caleb and gave him Hebron for an inheritance.
The name of Hebron before was Kiriath Arba, after the greatest man among the Anakim.
